conjecture: Top concentration: for an exact signed idempotent P with 0 < delta(P) <= 1/4, nonempty visible set W(P), hidden top vertex v of height H, and halo width a > 0 with H > a*tau (tau = sqrt(delta)), the positive mass v places outside the genuine set satisfies sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+ <= nu_v*(2+4*delta)/(H - a*tau), where G_a = {j : dist_1(p_j, conv{p_w : w in W}) > a*tau} and nu_v is the row-v negative mass.
